title: rest: `GET /meta/diagnostics` declares no closed query-parameter set, so a misspelled parameter name (`?typ=view`) answers a 200 full sweep
body:
domain:server#2 · os-sales · session_01L6bhgUCizoYWQVJWjhdR6F

Found in the contract review of PR #27620 (#27514), record `6500761231` (should-file, not that card's scope).

## What is wrong

PR #27620 makes the diagnostics route refuse an unknown VALUE of `type`, `severity` and `package`. An unknown parameter NAME is still ignored: the route declares no closed query-parameter set (no `refuseUnknownQueryParams` call), so `GET /api/v1/meta/diagnostics?typ=view` answers 200 with the full sweep. That is the same false all-clear class #27514 fixed, one axis over: the caller believes the answer is narrowed and it is not.

Re-check: `grep -n "refuseUnknownQueryParams\|refuseRepeatedQueryParams" packages/rest/src/meta-collection-routes.ts` (the diagnostics handler has the repeated-parameter refusal only).

## Expected

The diagnostics route declares its closed parameter set and refuses an unknown name with 400 `INVALID_REQUEST`, in the route's nested envelope, as the routes already converted under AGENTS.md's closed-parameter rule do. A narrowing: `Clause-②: no (narrowing)`, contract review before approval.

Filed without `domain:*`; grading is triage's.
